interpretation_notes: latest_departures are feasible approximate departure examples from a 5-step scan, not proven exact last opportunities.
estimated_arrival_step includes settle/exchange reserve; it means ready time or exchange completion time.
original task time displaced is not a measured loss of newly explored area.
visitors end at radius <=160 while SDK radio is strict distance <180; hub must be at origin for this contact guarantee.
23px clearance is checked on route body; a short start connector may retain existing 18px-or-greater clearance.
Routes are static geometric candidates. No control, dynamic collision, communication or new match simulation was run.
